ep.title: 제42구역: 속삭이는 거울 - 제1화
ep.summary: 조사관 강진우는 거울 속 변칙 존재로부터 자신의 잊혀진 과거를 듣게 된다.

scenes.speaker: kang
scenes.shot: English: Medium shot of kang leaning over the steel table in the dimly lit concrete interrogation room, staring intensely into the two-way mirror, cold flickering overhead light.

scenes.speaker: subject
scenes.shot: English: Close-up of subject's pitch-black eyes reflecting a distorted image, pale skin glowing faintly under the harsh fluorescent light, eerie smirk.

scenes.speaker: lee
scenes.shot: English: Medium shot of lee standing by the stainless steel desk, pushing up her wire-rimmed glasses with a trembling hand, looking anxiously at her tablet screen.

scenes.speaker: kang
scenes.shot: English: Close-up of kang turning his head slightly toward lee, sharp brown eyes filled with suspicion and irritation, dark circles prominent.

scenes.speaker: subject
scenes.shot: English: Extreme close-up of subject's mouth moving slowly, voice echoing chillingly through the metallic intercom speaker in the cold room.

scenes.speaker: kang
scenes.shot: English: Medium-close shot of kang slamming both hands onto the steel table, wide eyes filled with sudden shock and dread, sweat dripping down his sharp jawline.

scenes.speaker: subject
scenes.shot: English: Wide shot of the stark interrogation room, subject leaning forward against the glass, kang freezing in horror under the flickering light, tension peaking.

ep.cta: 과거의 진실은? 다음 화를 기대하세요! 구독과 좋아요
